coverLetter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am interested in the Business Intelligence and Analytics Manager - Palantir Foundry position at Molson Coors. My background combines technical leadership, systems integration, project coordination, and business data analysis. At DSTax Technologies, I serve as a Manager with lead developer and project management responsibilities for a tax-integration platform. The role’s emphasis on translating business needs into usable solutions connects directly with my experience coordinating technical delivery and helping clients implement and understand integrations.

Two examples illustrate that connection. At DSTax Technologies, I led the transition from Version 1 to Version 2 of the tax-integration platform, broadened financial-platform and tax-provider support, and improved UI/UX. My responsibilities also included managing internal development and client-coordinated work, communicating status, and supporting implementations from requirements gathering through setup, troubleshooting, and go-live. This work required connecting implementation details with client needs and providing guides and knowledge-base articles to support ongoing use. Earlier, at Komatsu Mining Corp. (Joy Global), I analyzed asset and facilities databases and identified more than $10 million in previously unidentified asset value. Those findings informed the sale of unused assets before Komatsu’s acquisition of Joy Global. I also evaluated, selected, and implemented a global mapping platform that made facility information available to employees and customers, providing another example of turning operational data into a useful business resource.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how this integration and delivery background could contribute to Molson Coors’ global Data, Analytics and AI team. The position’s combination of business collaboration, hands-on development, and responsibility for making solutions useful in daily operations is particularly appealing because it connects with the work described above. Thank you for considering my application.
Sincerely,
Kyle M. Anderson
reviewNotes: Emphasized technical leadership, client coordination, implementation support, financial-system integrations, and business data analysis. Retained warehouse and manufacturing-company experience for operational relevance. The master does not establish eight years in data and analytics, Palantir Foundry experience, Spark/PySpark, SAP/S4/HANA, ontology governance, ERP writeback webhooks, TypeScript/Vega, or Foundry application development. Project cost estimation, third-party BI delivery oversight, indirect-report management, and the specified full-life-cycle lead requirement are also not established.
